free_tier.stated: no free tier: pay-as-you-go at $0.07 a CPU-hour, $0.04375 a GB-hour of memory, and storage at $0.000683 a GB-hour running or $0.000027 stopped

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: $0.07 a CPU-hour and $0.04375 a GB-hour of memory while the machine runs
storage is billed at $0.000683 a GB-hour running and $0.000027 stopped, so a stopped machine still costs 4% of its running storage rate

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not documented. email is the assumed default because priced hosts require an account; sign-up requirements are unconfirmed for this provider.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
